approach: Byte-matching decompilation, compiled to wasm32 and wasm2c'd back to C to run natively on PsyZ with an SDL3 backend
notes: The main executable, all 37 overlays and WAD.WAD rebuild byte-identical from 100% matched C. The native build boots the title, plays the opening cutscene and loads and plays all 35 levels with sound, XA music and memory-card saves on macOS arm64 and Linux arm64/x86_64. Physics parity with the PS1 is still being checked.
help: Physics parity testing against the PS1
